tasks.gr7-personal-social-wellbeing-t4: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on personal and social well-being covering goal setting, exam stress, community responsibility, healthy routines, and future planning. Ask scenario questions about balancing wellbeing with study demands and making realistic plans.
tasks.gr7-physical-education-t4: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on physical education covering personal fitness plans, game strategy, participation review, and recreation. Ask learners to apply strategy in game contexts and evaluate their year-long physical development.
tasks.gr7-creative-arts-t4: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on creative arts covering portfolio curation, rehearsal discipline, integrated showcase preparation, and self-evaluation. Ask learners to choose evidence-based improvement steps and audience-focused presentation decisions.
tasks.gr7-diet-and-nutrition-t4: Topic: Diet and nutrition (Grade 7 Life Orientation, Term 4). Cover what the body needs from food, a balanced diet and a healthy eating plan, factors that influence food choices, and eating healthily on a small budget. No calorie numbers, weights or diets. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr7-common-diseases-tb-diabetes-epilepsy: Topic: Common diseases: TB, diabetes and epilepsy (Grade 7 Life Orientation, Term 4). Cover social, economic and environmental causes and risk factors (alcohol, tobacco, poor eating, inactivity), and for TB, diabetes and epilepsy what they are, signs, treatment, care and living well, and basic seizure first aid. Not contagious where true (diabetes, epilepsy). Respectful, no blame. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr7-common-diseases-obesity-anorexia-hiv: Topic: Common diseases: obesity, anorexia and HIV and AIDS (Grade 7 Life Orientation, Term 4). Cover obesity (health condition, habits, respect, no body-shaming), anorexia (eating disorder, warning signs, getting help from a trusted adult, clinic, counsellor, Childline 116), HIV and AIDS (what it is, how it is and is not passed on, treatment, no stigma, National AIDS Helpline 0800 012 322), and reliable health information. No weights, calorie numbers or BMI targets. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
tasks.gr7-oral-traditions-and-scriptures-t4: Topic: Oral traditions and scriptures of major religions (Grade 7 Life Orientation, Term 4). Describe, never rank, the role of oral traditions and the scriptures of Judaism (Tanakh, Torah), Christianity (Bible), Islam (Qur'an), Hinduism (Vedas, Bhagavad Gita), Buddhism (Tripitaka) and African traditional beliefs (oral traditions). Use 'many followers believe'. Ask the learner directly (you), never about learners or CAPS.
